row-hover.$description: Hovered list or table row sitting directly on the page.

row-pressed.$description: Pressed row on the page. Pressable rows contain no links.

row-selected.$description: Selected row on the page, with border.selected. Same on hover and press.

$root.$description: Cards, panels and other raised surfaces.

row-pressed.$description: Pressed row inside a card. Dark is the same as hover; the press effect is designed with the row component.

row-selected.$description: Selected row inside a card, with border.selected. Same on hover and press.

error.$description: Banner and inline-message background for error, with text.error, icon.error and border.error.subtle.

warning.$description: Banner and inline-message background for warning, with text.warning, icon.warning and border.warning.subtle.

success.$description: Banner and inline-message background for success, with text.success, icon.success and border.success.subtle.

info.$description: Banner and inline-message background for info, with text.info, icon.info and border.info.subtle.
